title: The Cost page names each mission, and a row's unpriced badge is short enough to keep its dollars on the page
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/serve.rs (`cost`, `label_cost_tasks`), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/labels.rs (`label_cost`, `mission_name`), web/src/cost.ts (`costView`, `Row`, `unpricedText`) and web/src/components/cost/CostView.tsx (`Rows`, `UnpricedMark`).

The problem. lead-mac's screenshot of the Cost page after 059 went live (sync/page-cost-2026-11-12-0158.png) shows two faults.
- The Missions column says "#4", "#6", "#7", "#8" and nothing else, while every other page names them ("Spawn RSI", "Supply PA", "Spawn · owner work"). `/api/cost`'s missions rows carry no name.
- In the 7-day Agents column at 1400 px, a row with an unpriced badge ("+ 485,321,042 tokens unpriced") pushes its dollars past the right edge ("$161.5", and "$" cut off on the next rows). The badge spells out the whole count, and neither the agent's name nor the badge can shrink.

Required behaviour.
(a) Every `missions` row of `/api/cost` carries `name`: the mission's `mission_name` exactly as `/api/missions` gives it, or null for a mission the record does not hold. costView's mission Row carries it as `label`, and the page shows it beside the mission's id ("#4 Spawn RSI"), as task rows show theirs.
(b) Every Row carries `unpriced_short`: "+<n> unpriced", or null with none.
- <n> is the count made compact: "950", "55K", "1.1M", "17M", "485M", "1.5B". It has one decimal under 10 and is whole from 10, with K, M or B by thousands.
- `unpriced_text` (059's full count) stays, for the badge's title.
(c) The page's badge shows the short text, and the full count is in its title. A row's dollars never shrink, wrap or leave the column at 1400 px: a long name truncates instead.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/075.sh. The history is seeded as the store holds it, priced by the loop's cost step (bb-model-x priced, bb-model-z not), and `spawn serve` answers.
- Mission 1 ("Bb Alpha: ...", named "Bb Alpha") has task 1, which calls x for 100,000 tokens and z for 485,321,042.
- Mission 2 ("Owner work on Bb Beta: ...", named "Bb Beta · owner work") has task 2, which calls z for 1,148,834.
Checks:
- (1) `/api/cost?window=24h`'s missions rows carry exactly the names `/api/missions` gives. Under node, costView's mission Rows carry them as `label`.
- (2) Under node, `unpriced_short` is "+485M unpriced" for mission 1, T1 and its agent, and "+1.1M unpriced" for mission 2, T2 and its agent. T1's `unpriced_text` is still "+ 485,321,042 tokens unpriced". The steps 950, 55,000, 1,148,834, 17,000,456, 485,321,042, 1,463,163,060 and 0 read "+950", "+55K", "+1.1M", "+17M", "+485M" and "+1.5B unpriced", and null.
It fails with 1 on 820d5372: mission rows carry no name, and Rows no short badge.

The product reason. The Cost page is where the owner looks for where the money goes. A bare "#6" makes them look up which mission that is, and a dollar figure cut off at the edge is a figure they cannot read.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (059's and 068's included) and add tests of your own: a serve test of the missions' names (a mission the record does not hold is null), and web/test tests for (a) and (b).
